column1: # Pre-registered experiment manifest — Block B: firm up Mellum's 15/17 on
# editing tasks at real n. Written BEFORE the first run.
# NOT an amendment to experiment-manifest.tsv (P17), which is complete and
# closed. P17's seeds 1-3 are already recorded there and are NEVER re-run or
# overwritten; this manifest uses disjoint seeds 4-23 so the two bodies of
# evidence stay independent and can be pooled or read separately.
# Design: 3 editing fixtures x rounds=2 x seeds 4..23 = 60 cells.
#   - rounds fixed at 2. P17 measured no budget effect on editing (8/8 at
#     rounds=2 vs 7/9 at rounds=5) and rounds=2 is the cheaper cell. Holding
#     it fixed makes this a MEASUREMENT of one configuration, not a comparison.
#   - framing-2 (author+edit, 1/6) is deliberately EXCLUDED. This block
#     measures the editing claim only; the authoring limit is a separate
#     question and mixing them is what produced the pooled number being firmed.
# Adding rows after runs begin invalidates the pre-registration.
